result.prior_version_note: The interest requirement itself is not new; only the annual rate changes. D083 lists 5.0% for March 1, 2025 – February 28, 2026 and 5.2% for March 1, 2024 – February 28, 2025. It also points to a separate list of earlier rates (572), so the requirement predates 2024. The date it first applied is not given in the documents.
